text.name: Paragraph
text.text: The owner has tested playing, knob edits, the reactive display, EXIT and repeated Synth entry on P6S. Ordinary sample pads work after returning to the sampler.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: The next openSynth candidate adds direct recording onto an empty pad while retaining the working synth. Capture, saving, playback and the candidate's native resource and runtime checks still need qualification. A larger editing interface is being developed separately.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text:
Playing and editing
Hardware-tested P6S checkpoint: 16 sounds, four voices, responsive waveform and sampler return.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text:
Recording to a pad
Pending. The proposed direct workflow selects an empty pad before recording. Capture, saving, saved-pad playback and persistence need qualification on the exact image.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text:
USB updates
Verified for the byte-identical P6S image through an already-installed USB BRIDGE B2, including a browser write and cold reboot.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text:
Firmware download
No public release package yet. A local source build does not make a held image ready to install.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: These controls describe the working P6S checkpoint. Its literal build marker remains SYNTH P6S!; openSynth is the product name. Successor recording controls below are still pending.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text:
Enter Synth
Hold SHIFT and press RECORD SETTING. Release SHIFT, select Synth in the chooser and press VALUE. If TAP SHIFT appears, tap and release SHIFT.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text:
Play and edit
Play notes and chords on the pads. CTRL 1, CTRL 2 and CTRL 3 edit the current page. Press VALUE to cycle TONE, OSC, AMP and MOD.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text:
Choose a sound
Hold SHIFT and press VALUE to open MENU. Turn VALUE to SOUND, press it, then turn to a sound and press to apply. VOICE offers MONO and POLY4.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text:
Return to samples
EXIT backs out of a menu. SHIFT plus VALUE returns directly to play. EXIT from the playing page leaves Synth; ordinary sample pads then play in the sampler.

text.name: Heading
text.text: Record a melody onto a pad

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: Stay inside openSynth to choose a destination, record and save. This direct workflow is under development and is not enabled in P6S. Recording while a pattern and other samples continue still needs its own qualification.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: The candidate uses a bounded manual take with a 120-second maximum and no count-in. The recording screen shows elapsed time and progress; REC stops earlier. The supported length and complete save route still need physical testing.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: 1. While playing openSynth, press REC to show available empty pads. Occupied or unavailable pads cannot be chosen. Use a backed-up project for the first test.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: 2. Press an empty pad to choose the destination. This press selects the pad without playing a synth note. EXIT cancels the chooser.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: 3. Press REC to start. Play your melody on the pads, which now play notes normally. Watch the elapsed time and progress toward the 120-second limit.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: 4. Press REC again to stop and save to the chosen pad. At the limit the take ends automatically. Wait for the explicit save result, then return to the sampler and play the pad. Confirm the sample remains after a cold reboot.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: The first direct workflow protects occupied pads. Pattern overlap, sustained recording, MIDI and stored user patches need their own physical checks. The public release will describe only the behavior its final image passes.

text.name: Figure provenance
text.text: Illustrative openSynth interface from the shared Penpot components. These are original designs, not device captures. Direct recording is pending qualification.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: The feature picker exports your choices. The patcher runs locally with your unchanged official Roland v5.52 firmware and reviewed original source. It requires the matched Python and Arm toolchain; compilation is not performed in the browser. The direct-recording candidate's build and delivery handoff are still being integrated.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: USB BRIDGE B2 must already be installed and freshly identified. Normal stock USB audio and MIDI do not provide this firmware writer. First installation from untouched stock over ordinary USB remains unsupported.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: 1. Choose Synth and its shortcut in the feature picker. Export the configuration for the local patcher.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: 2. Build with your official v5.52 firmware, reviewed source bundle and matching tools. Inspect the configuration, candidate hashes and separate P6S restoration.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: 3. For an admitted image, cold-boot into the installed B2 writer and identify its version, chip and supported image format before an upload.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: 4. Require complete flash readback and a separately reopened status check. Remove power and USB-C, boot normally and confirm the new build; then verify a fresh DEL boot retains B2.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: Unqualified candidates remain held. The verified P6S browser update is an exact-image result and does not qualify another image, a first installation or failed-image recovery.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: A physical P6S audio/video take and browser USB roundtrip are recorded. The owner confirmed cold boot, sample playback, two EXIT and reentry cycles, and a fresh DEL/B2 return. Audio/video synchronization is not calibrated.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: The openSynth recording release must pass its native startup and memory checks, audio deadlines, capture and saving, saved-pad playback, cold persistence and return to normal sampler use. Global recording across normal sampler and effect pages is a separate feature with incomplete hardware coverage.

text.name: Paragraph
text.text: Updated 6 October 2026. This page describes the current checkpoint and planned workflow; it is not an installation approval or a public firmware release.

text.text: The openSynth recording release must pass its native startup and memory checks, audio deadlines, capture and saving, saved-pad playback, cold persistence and return to normal sampler use. Global recording across normal sampler and effect pages is a separate feature with incomplete hardware coverage.
